tests.exercises: GM+IE+IM/CIMI: the kinetic ring current in the IM slot with restart
tests.why: regression against Param/SWPC/TestOutput* at 1e-5 relative on the GM log, 2e-4 on magnetometers, ionosphere and geoindex files; the first steady-state steps are deterministic and the time-accurate 120 s window is short, so pointwise holds; the check must shorten the steady iterations (MaxIter 70 and 200 are already the test values) and keep the 2-minute time-accurate window
